template: In the Ghost admin, open the draft post titled '{{v1}}' and publish it using the app's publish confirmation flow: click the Publish button, then in the confirmation dialog that appears confirm publishing the post now (choose the option that publishes immediately, not scheduling). Complete the whole confirmation flow until the post is actually published. Then verify: the post's status must be {{v3}} (not {{v4}}, not Scheduled) — check the editor status indicator and the posts list row for this post. Report the exact status shown, and confirm the post is publicly visible by opening the post's public URL {{v7}} in the browser and reporting the page title and whether the body paragraph containing {{v2}} is visible there.

reportTemplate.summary: {{v3}} the draft '{{v1}}' through the app's publish confirmation flow: Publish → "Right now" → Continue, final review → "Publish post, right now" (the immediate-publish option, not scheduling). Ghost confirmed with "Boom! It's out there. That's 4 posts published." The post's status is now {{v3}} everywhere I checked — the editor status indicator reads "{{v3}}" (and the editor offers Unpublish + a "{{v3}} / View post" link), and the posts list row reads "{{v1}} … By Bench Admin in Bench News - 01 Sep 2026 … {{v3}}". The public URL {{v7}} loads with page heading "{{v1}}" and the body paragraph "This bench post was created by run {{v2}}." visible, so the post is publicly live. The three Seed: posts were left untouched.
